vo: 都说量子计算机，能同时算所有答案
sub: 都说量子计算机，能同时算所有答案
picture: Frame 0: dark scope graticule, one green trace already running on CH1. On the first beat (<1 s) the trace bursts into dozens of traces fanning out across the screen (the "every answer at once" image). Chapter label top-left: 00 · 传说.

vo: 这句话，其实很误导
sub: 这句话，其实很误导
picture: The fan of traces freezes; a vertical cursor sweeps through it and a red readout stamps 误导 ✗ over the fan.

vo: 谷歌的芯片，不到五分钟算完一道题
sub: 谷歌的芯片，不到5分钟算完一道题
picture: Trace morphs into a two-channel compare. CH2 (red): a short sharp burst that ends almost at once; red readout "< 5 分钟" lands on a beat.

vo: 顶级超算估计要十的二十五次方年
sub: 顶级超算估计要 10²⁵ 年
screen: CH1 · 最快的超级计算机之一
远超宇宙年龄 · Google 估计
picture: CH1 (green): a trace that never ends, running off the right edge; the white mono readout counts up zero by zero to 10,000,000,000,000,000,000,000,000 年 (tag: 最快的超级计算机之一 · Google 估计). In the VO-free 11.5–14.2 s the counter is STILL running and the CH1 trace still moving, and a big second readout lands on a beat: 远超宇宙年龄 (138 亿年 marked as a tiny tick at the far left of the time axis). Energy rises into the drop; nothing static.

vo: 你手机的运行内存，有几百亿个比特
sub: 你手机的运行内存，有几百亿个比特
picture: CH1: a dense digital square wave (bit stream) scrolling fast. Readout: 8 GB 运行内存（以此计）≈ 64,000,000,000 bit.

vo: 每个都是躺平的硬币
sub: 每个都是躺平的硬币
picture: Zoom into one step of the square wave: its two levels are two coins lying flat, seen edge-on as flat lines, labelled 0 and 1. Nothing moves between them.

vo: 那块芯片，只有一百零五个量子比特
sub: 那块芯片，只有105个量子比特
picture: Hard switch: a small grid of 105 dots (one per qubit) draws on in a few sweeps; big red readout 105 next to the dim 64,000,000,000.

vo: 这类芯片，要比太空冷一百多倍
sub: 这类芯片，要比太空冷100多倍
picture: A temperature channel: the trace falls down a log axis past 外太空 2.7 K and settles at ≈10 mK; a ΔY cursor between 2.7 K and 10 mK reads ×100+. Label: 超导量子芯片 (no Willow figure).

vo: 就凭这一百零五个？
sub: 就凭这105个？
picture: Both readouts side by side, 64,000,000,000 bit (dim) vs 105 qubit (red), cursor blinking on the 105. Music starts to fall away.

vo: 你可以把量子比特，想成旋转的硬币
sub: 你可以把量子比特，想成旋转的硬币
picture: Quiet. One channel, slow sweep. A coin spinning, shown as the scope sees it: its edge traces a slow sine wave. Small label 示意 in the corner. Chapter label: 02 · 量子比特.

vo: 转着的时候，零和一叠加在一起
sub: 转着的时候，0和1[叠加]在一起
picture: The sine splits into two thin component traces labelled |0⟩ and |1⟩ that sum back into the one wave.

vo: 一测量，它就随机倒向一面
sub: 一测量，它就随机倒向一面
picture: A red trigger marker drops; the wave freezes and collapses to a flat line at level 1. Readout → 1. Silence on the music.

vo: 每面的概率，看振幅，也就是波有多高
sub: 每面的概率，看[振幅]，也就是波有多高
picture: The two component waves from b2 come back; a vertical dimension arrow measures each one's height, labelled 振幅 = 波的高度. Beside it, the coin spins and drops again and again, and a small histogram of 0s and 1s builds up with bar heights matching the two waves. Readout P = |振幅|².

vo: 两枚硬币一起转，就有四种组合
sub: 2枚硬币一起转，就有4种组合
picture: Build starts. Two spinning-coin traces merge, and the screen splits into 4 channels |00⟩ |01⟩ |10⟩ |11⟩, all running at once, each its own wave. Readout 2 枚 → 4 种组合.

vo: 每多一枚，组合就翻一倍
sub: 每多一枚，组合就翻一倍
picture: Channels keep doubling faster than the eye can count (8, 16, 32 …); the channel-count readout ticks on the beats; label 2ⁿ.

vo: 十枚，就是一千零二十四种
picture: ten coin channels; readout 1,024

vo: 三百枚，组合比宇宙的原子还多
sub: 300枚，组合比宇宙的原子还多
screen: 可观测宇宙的原子 ≈ 10⁸⁰（估算）
picture: The traces merge into a solid wall of phosphor glow. Two readouts stacked: 2³⁰⁰ ≈ 2×10⁹⁰ 种组合 above 可观测宇宙的原子 ≈10⁸⁰ (估算); the top one overflows its box.

vo: 所以它是把所有答案，同时算了一遍？
sub: 所以它是把所有答案，同时算了一遍？
picture: The hook's question returns over the glowing wall, cursor blinking, music at its highest. Must END by 62.5 s.

vo: 不是。
sub: 不是。
picture: ON THE DROP (63.1): a trigger cuts the wall; every trace collapses at once into a single spike. Red ✗ over 同时算所有答案.

vo: 一测量，只倒出一个答案
sub: 一测量，只倒出一个答案
picture: Readout: MEASURE → |1011…⟩, 1 个 · 随机. The rest of the screen is empty graticule.

vo: 真正的本事，叫干涉
sub: 真正的本事，叫[干涉]
picture: Chapter label 05 · 干涉. Three rows appear: CH1, CH2 and the MATH channel (CH1 + CH2) below them.

vo: 振幅像波，峰撞上谷就抵消
sub: 振幅像波，峰撞上谷就抵消
picture: CH1 a wave, CH2 the same wave upside down; MATH draws live and comes out flat. Label 波峰 + 波谷 = 0.

vo: 你的降噪耳机，靠的就是它
sub: 你的降噪耳机，靠的就是它
screen: CH2 耳机放出的反相波
picture: Same three rows, relabelled: CH1 噪声 (a ragged hum), CH2 耳机放出的反相波, MATH ≈ 安静 (almost flat). A simple line icon of headphones, no hands or faces.

vo: 算法让错的答案，互相抵消
sub: 算法让错的答案，互相抵消
picture: KEY FRAME: back to the 8 channels. Each wrong answer's trace meets its dashed mirror ghost and goes flat, one after another.

vo: 对的答案，越叠越强
sub: 对的答案，越叠越强
picture: |101⟩ turns red and its wave grows taller with each cycle; the readout climbs to 94.1 %, with the 示意 tag attached to the readout from its first frame.

vo: 最后一测，大概率就是它
sub: 最后一测，大概率就是它
picture: Trigger fires; the result readout shows RESULT 101 in red. Small 示意.

vo: 所以它只在少数题上快得离谱
sub: 所以它只在少数题上快得离谱
picture: Two-row readout: 少数题 ▲▲▲快得离谱 vs 大多数题 ▲ 强不了多少 (Aaronson, SciAm 2008). The VO only reads the first row.

vo: 开头那道题只是测速，本身还没什么用
sub: 开头那道题只是测速，本身还没什么用
screen: 测速题 · 暂无实际用途（Google）
picture: Callback: the hook's two-channel compare comes back small, and a stamp lands across it: 测速题 · 暂无实际用途 (Google's own words).

vo: 真正的用处，将来或许是新药和电池
sub: 真正的用处，将来或许是新药和电池
screen: 分子模拟 → 新药 · 电池
picture: A channel draws a simple molecule outline as a Lissajous figure; labels 新药 · 电池 and a small tag 将来 · 可能.

vo: 理论上，它还擅长分解大数
sub: 理论上，它还擅长分解大数
picture: A long number on the readout splits into two factors: N = p × q. Tag Shor · 1994.

vo: 而你用的很多加密，就靠大数难分解
sub: 而你用的很多加密，就靠大数难分解
picture: The number is wrapped by a padlock drawn as a trace; label RSA · 靠「大数难分解」. Small 你 marker on the lock (the viewer's data).

vo: 你今天的加密数据，可以先存着以后解
sub: 你今天的加密数据，可以先存着以后解
screen: 先存后解 HARVEST NOW, DECRYPT LATER（NIST）
picture: The padlocked trace is captured into the scope's REF memory slot (a saved waveform, dimmed, time stamp 今天) while a time readout runs fast forward. Big label 先存后解; source tag NIST.

vo: 破解它，估计要不到一百万个量子比特
sub: 破解它，估计要不到一百万个量子比特
screen: 什么时候？专家估计 几年～几十年
picture: Log-scale ΔY cursors: top cursor at < 1,000,000 labelled 破解 RSA-2048（估计）, bottom cursor at Willow 105 (red); the gap between them is the tall empty space. Small readout: 什么时候？专家估计 几年～几十年 (NIST), on screen only.

vo: 谷歌那块才一百零五个，可门槛还在降
sub: 谷歌那块才105个，可门槛还在降
screen: 好在：抗量子加密标准已发布（NIST · 2024.08）
picture: The top cursor slides down: 2019 20,000,000 → 2025 <1,000,000 → 2026 ↓ (新论文更少), and the gap to 105 narrows. As the line ends, a green stamp lands on the padlock: 好在：抗量子加密标准已发布（NIST · 2024.08）. It stays through the beat before the payoff.

vo: 好在，抗量子的新加密标准，已经发布了
sub: 好在，抗量子的新加密标准，已经发布了
screen: 好在：抗量子加密标准已发布
picture: green stamp on the lock thumbnail

vo: 它快，不是因为算得多
sub: 它快，不是因为算得多
picture: Payoff: the 8-channel key frame again, wide. 算得多 struck through.

vo: 而是它让错的答案，自己抵消
sub: 而是它让错的答案，自己抵消
picture: Seven traces go flat together, one red trace stays: ✓ 错的抵消.

vo: 谁说它能同时算所有答案
sub: 谁说它能同时算所有答案
picture: The fan of traces from frame 0 returns for a moment, struck by the red ✗.

vo: 就把这条发给谁
sub: 就把这条发给谁
